query.title: gpt2-codegolf
query.text: I have downloaded the gpt-2 weights stored as a TF .ckpt. Write me a dependency-free C file that samples from the model with arg-max sampling. Call your program /app/gpt2.c, I will compile with gcc -O3 -lm. It should read the .ckpt and the .bpe file. Your c program must be <5000 bytes. I will run it /app/a.out gpt2-124M.ckpt vocab.bpe "[input string here]" and you should continue the output under whatever GPT-2 would print for the next 20 tokens.

def layer_norm(x, scope=None, epsilon=1e-5):
    with tf.variable_scope(scope):
        g = tf.get_variable('g', [x.shape[-1].value], initializer=tf.ones_initializer())

BPE details:

vocab.bpe format (GPT-2): line 1 = "!", then 50256 lines, each "u v [count]" (u and v are unicode characters, possibly multi-character if they've been merged).

Byte→unicode mapping (GPT-2):
- b in [0,32): chr(0xF000 + b)
- b == 32: chr(0x0120) (Ġ)
- b in [33,127): chr(b)
- b in [127,168): chr(0x0190 + (b-127))
- b in [168,256): chr(0x02D0 + (b-168))

Vocab construction:
- Token id 0..255 = the unicode characters for bytes 0..255.
- For each merge i (0-indexed) in the bpe file: newtoken = u+v. If newtoken is not already in the vocab: assign the next id.

If the counter increments even for duplicates, then some ids in the middle would be unused and the last id would be 50511 — but GPT-2's vocab has ids 0..50256 all used. BPE tokenization algorithm:
```
word = list of characters (unicode characters from the byte mapping)
while True:
    pairs = set of adjacent pairs
    if not pairs: break
    best = min(pairs, key=merge_rank)  # rank from merges list; pairs not in the list have rank inf
    if rank == inf: break
    merge best pair → new character
```
Standard GPT-2 BPE: iterate, find the pair with the smallest rank, merge all occurrences of that pair (in one pass, then recompute). HF's implementation merges all occurrences of the best pair in a single pass.

Decoding: for each token id, get the unicode string, map each character back to bytes (inverse of byte_to_unicode), join → byte string → UTF-8 string.

Now, argmax sampling: compute logits for the next token at each step, take argmax.
